origin.description: Compare two files after stripping banners, pointers, and trailing space.
origin.usage: Rdiff(from, to, useDiff = FALSE, forEx = FALSE, nullPointers = TRUE, Log = FALSE)

arguments.name: useDiff
arguments.text: When true, run the system diff program.

origin.details: Trailing space is ignored. A pointer such as <environment: 0xabc> becomes <environment: 0>. Curly quotes become straight quotes.
origin.value: 0 when the files agree, 1 when lines differ, 2 when the line counts differ.
origin.example:
a <- tempfile(); b <- tempfile()
writeLines("alpha", a); writeLines("alpha", b)
cat(Rdiff(a, b), "\n")

translation.description: Compare two files after stripping banners, pointers, and trailing space.
translation.usage: rdiff(from_file, to_file, use_diff=False, for_ex=False, null_pointers=True, log=False)

arguments.name: useDiff
arguments.text: When true, run the system diff program.

translation.details: Trailing space is ignored. A pointer such as <environment: 0xabc> becomes <environment: 0>. Curly quotes become straight quotes.
translation.value: 0 when the files agree, 1 when lines differ, 2 when the line counts differ.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from tools.rdiff import rdiff
a = Path(tempfile.mktemp()); b = Path(tempfile.mktemp())
a.write_text("alpha\n"); b.write_text("alpha\n")
print(rdiff(a, b))
